title: erucastrum varium var. campestre
intro: Erucastrum varium var. campestre, commonly known as Field Rocket or Rocket, is a perennial plant in the Brassicaceae family. It is valued for its edible leaves and seeds, which have been used for their health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Erucastrum varium var. campestre include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
